description_ru: Современные отложения. Аллювиальные отложения пойменных террас. Суглинки, супеси, пески
note: GGK-200 O-43-XXV (Geologicheskaya karta SSSR, Ishim series, 1st edition; Novosibirsk TGU, N.N. Slotin, ed. I.P. Varlamov; approved VSEGEI/SNIIGGIMS 22.12.1964; printed VAGT Leningrad 1970; 72-73E 56d40m-57d20mN), Quaternary map; RASTER = geokniga 1939x2385 px PREVIEW (~34 m/px); vertical lithology ruling removed (work/r200d/prep_vlines.py); fills = map tints snap-sampled at labelled units (work/r200h/snap.py), el+d/l+h/alQIII2 calibrated on the map (drift cap 4 dE), alQIV / lQIIbh / alQII-III3 pinned and matched tightly (--class-dE 4/4/6: alQIV prints 5.5 dE from the el+d plain, lQIIbh 6.6 dE from the hatched l+h); el+dQIII (subaerial cover loams) coded E, hclass2 W (PI decision 2026-10-04); lakes print near-white-cyan: read as l+h; frame = 4 measured corners + mid-side lines + interior 15x10 min graticule crossings as ties (work/r200h/O-43-XXV/ties_final.txt) ; seed = map tint; floodplains print 6 dE greener than the el+d plain
